notes.title: Beta: Battle Effects Gameplay Feature, Snappier Ui and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Over the past little while, I have been working hard on Foe Frenzy's first major update. See here what that'll mean for the game and how you can test the new features already!

Fancy Ui
Remember the old, slow and boring Ui? Well, it's been spiced up quite a bit. Check it out:
https://i.imgur.com/GgUu68P.gif

Battle Effects
While seeing you all play Foe Frenzy, I noticed that the battles in the game can be spiced up quite a bit. The coming update will introduce Battle Effects to the game: Items that spawn randomly around the map during battle, that, when picked up by a player, will inflict effects to their enemies: Slowness, icey stunning and more!
https://i.imgur.com/m2L2j0g.gif

Tiebreaker
Ever feel like a battle just drags on for too long while the last two players hide from each other? Well, not anymore: During the last minute of battle, players will now see their health bars sliding off the screen - everyone only has a single health point remaining. In this situation, the tiniest mistake could cost anyone that win.
https://i.imgur.com/4LckbXA.gif

Try It Now
To get access to the beta for this upcoming update, all you have to do is go into your Steam Library, right-click on Foe Frenzy, select Properties, head into the Betas tab and select the "beta" branch from the dropdown!

Have fun trying it out!
